texts.value: Photolyase involved in the repair of UV-induced (6-4) lesions in DNA. Catalyzes the photoreactivation of (6-4) pyrimidine-pyrimidone photoproducts by using blue-light energy. Can repair (6-4) photoproducts in ssDNA as well as in dsDNA
Cells lacking this gene show a strongly attenuated photoreactivation after treatment with UV-B irradiation
Belongs to the iron-sulfur bacterial cryptochrome/photolyase (FeS-BCP) family
